_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS R1241's VALUE HALF IS NOT VACUOUS — run it from the
repository root:
cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/injection-harness/Cargo.toml -- sweep \
tools/unread-declaration/injection-sweep.json
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. The key half of this gate asks the program; the value
half cannot, because whether a substring names anything is a question about
THIS repository, which the program has never seen. So it asks the VCS: every
token of `writes` reaches something tracked, and every sweep this repository
tracks is reached by some token.
EXISTENCE IS NOT ENOUGH AND THAT IS WHY THERE ARE FOUR. `.sweep.json` named
four of twenty-three manifests — the token matched something, every key was
read as declared, and nineteen sweeps ran on a build machine with the tracked
evidence they write left behind. So one injection removes the coverage half
and one removes the existence half; a third stops printing the counts, which
are the only thing that tells four-of-twenty-three from all-of-them; and the
fourth turns the refusal into an answer, because a tree this gate cannot ask
about must not come back clean.
Scoped to this crate's own suite: nothing here touches the tree it judges.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
beside this file, so a run sent to a build machine leaves its evidence on a
throwaway copy (R1205's carry, and the `writes` line in the declaration).

injections.name: no-sweep-is-asked-whether-a-token-reaches-it
injections.why: the defect exactly as it stood, and the one this half was written after. With the coverage loop gone the law asks only whether each token names SOMETHING, which `.sweep.json` did — four of twenty-three — while nineteen sweeps ran elsewhere and their tracked evidence stayed there. Every key read as declared, every token naming a file, and the thing the declaration was written to do not happening

injections.name: a-token-that-names-nothing-is-taken-as-naming-something
injections.why: the other direction, and the `exclude` shape one key over: a token the program dutifully looks for and no command here can contain. Five repositories declared that key and nothing read it, which was invisible until a build machine failed a compile for a missing header

injections.name: the-reach-of-a-token-is-computed-and-not-printed
injections.why: a count nobody can read is a count nobody watches drift. Four of twenty-three and twenty-three of twenty-three are both `matches something`, so the number is the whole of what tells them apart — and a reader who never sees it on a GREEN run cannot notice the day it falls. R1130 measured this shape: a field read and never printed

injections.name: a-tree-this-gate-cannot-ask-about-is-called-clean
injections.why: the third exit code, which this repository keeps paying for: a check that never ran reports zero findings, and zero findings is what a clean tree looks like. Both populations come from the VCS, so a tree without one has no answer — and swallowing that into an empty list turns `I could not look` into `there is nothing there`

edits.from: .map_err(|why| format!("which sweeps this repository tracks could not be asked — {why}"))?
